security updates: CVE-2024-45338: uplift golang.org/x/net version to 0.33.0 by @sharimsft in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/scheduler-plugins/pull/857
Fix CVE-2023-47108 in go.opentelemetry.io by @jgu17 in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/scheduler-plugins/pull/742
Golang.org/x/net is bumped to v0.23.0 to address CVE-2023-45288 (#714, @Huang-Wei)

breaking changes: The API Group of CRD `PodGroup` and `ElasticQuota` is migrated to `scheduling.x-k8s.io`. The brand new installations don't need to do anything. Users migrating to this release need to do the following steps:
use `kubectl replace -f <crds>` to ensure new CRDs function well
migrate the labels - new label is using a style of `*.scheduling.x-k8s.io/<label-name>`, e.g., `scheduling.x-k8s.io/pod-group`

Helm chart now leverages `--namespace scheduler-plugins --create-namespace` to consolidate both Helm release meta info and chart artifacts in the same namespace. Moreover, it enables users to customize the installation namespace.
